question: If AI makes the economy bigger, how do we make sure ordinary workers share in the gains?
reflection: Planning for several possible futures now gives societies time to protect workers and spread new wealth more fairly.

sources.subject: China's AI copying allegations just got bigger
OpenAI cuts image latency 50% while Anthropic maps your job's AI risk

one_line: Debate is sharpening over who benefits from AI: workers or capital, US labs or their rivals, speed or safety.

top_stories.title: Anthropic maps three futures for jobs and wages
top_stories.what: Anthropic released an interactive tool with modest, substantial and extreme scenarios for AI's effect on the US economy by 2030, treating each job as a bundle of tasks.
top_stories.why: Task-based scenarios are a practical template for labour-market agencies planning skills and income policy.

top_stories.title: US agencies accuse Chinese labs of copying models
top_stories.what: The FBI, NSA and CISA say six Chinese AI firms, including DeepSeek and Alibaba, used distillation at industrial scale to learn from American models; China rejects the claims.
top_stories.why: Where learning ends and copying begins will shape which models organisations can safely buy and build on.

top_stories.title: Insiders warn the AI race is moving too fast
top_stories.what: OpenAI's chief scientist says no lab has solved alignment well enough to scale at full speed, and a researcher resigned from Anthropic over the pace toward self-improving systems.
top_stories.why: Public trust in AI depends on visible safety work, which matters to any government rolling out AI services.

saudi_lens.text: No direct Saudi or regional link today.

idea.title: Simulated users before real trials
idea.pitch: Amazon reportedly predicts A/B test winners with AI-simulated users; test whether this could pre-screen behavioural nudges before field trials, while keeping real trials as the final check.
idea.first_step: Pick two past nudge trials with known results and see whether simulated users rank the options the same way.

idea_kids.title: Jobs of tomorrow board game
idea_kids.pitch: Children move through a town where each job card shows tasks that machines help with and tasks that need people, then design a new job.
idea_kids.first_step: Write fifteen job cards from local life, such as baker, nurse and teacher, each with three tasks.

terms.definition: Training a smaller model on the answers of a stronger one so it learns to behave similarly.
The part of a country's total income that goes to workers as wages, rather than to owners of capital.
An experiment that shows two versions of something to different groups to see which works better.

concepts.summary: Scenario tools show AI could grow the economy while lowering workers' share.
US agencies accuse Chinese labs of learning from American models without permission.
Lab insiders warn the race toward self-improving AI outpaces safety work.
